benchmarks.name: Epoch Capabilities Index
benchmarks.blurb: Epoch's composite score that stitches dozens of benchmarks onto one scale, so models tested on different suites can be compared.

benchmarks.name: GPQA Diamond
benchmarks.blurb: 198 graduate-level biology, chemistry, and physics questions written so that skilled non-experts with web access still miss them.

benchmarks.name: FrontierMath (Tiers 1-3)
benchmarks.blurb: Unpublished research-level math problems with automatically checkable answers; most take specialists hours to solve.

benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Verified
benchmarks.blurb: Real GitHub issues from Python repositories; a model passes when its patch makes the hidden tests pass. Run by Epoch with a fixed scaffold.

benchmarks.name: Humanity's Last Exam
benchmarks.blurb: 2,500 expert-written questions across dozens of fields, built to sit at the edge of human knowledge. Scores reported by the developers.

benchmarks.name: ARC-AGI-2
benchmarks.blurb: Abstract grid puzzles that test learning a new rule from a few examples. Results from the ARC Prize semi-private set.

benchmarks.name: METR time horizon
benchmarks.blurb: How long a software task (measured in skilled-human time) a model can finish with 50% reliability.

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 2.0
benchmarks.blurb: Hard command-line tasks done end to end inside a sandbox. Each row is a model paired with an agent harness.
